transport: LuCI rpc.declare using the existing authenticated same-origin LuCI session
package_dependency: airbridge-media (file-management API requires backend 1.0.0-r4 or newer; custom signed helper dependency owned by lead)

upload_transport.url: L.env.cgi_base + '/airbridge-media-upload', a validated fixed same-origin path, no query parameters
upload_transport.luci_request_cache: Set options.cache=true and omit query: installed LuCI otherwise appends a timestamp query to POST too. This preserves the fixed URL, not HTTP response caching; CGI sends Cache-Control:no-store.
upload_transport.authorization: Bearer <existing LuCI session id>:<opaque 64-lowerhex token>:<decimal byte offset>
upload_transport.body: 1..1048576 raw bytes from file.slice(start,end). Pass request.post a content callback function(xhr){capture xhr;return Blob}, never pass a Blob directly because LuCI JSON-stringifies objects.
upload_transport.reply: ok,error,offset:next byte,size:declared total,complete:boolean,path:relative. UI checks every field against expected byte range/path. Final nonempty chunk atomically publishes without overwrite; there is no finish request.
upload_transport.coordination: One file and one chunk at a time. No automatic retry/resume or whole-file memory/root/tmp buffering. Best-effort upload_cancel on error/cancel; refresh library because a committed final response may be lost.
upload_transport.cancel: Set cancellation state, abort captured XHR, await best-effort upload_cancel and refresh storage/library; completed files may remain. Never clear or overwrite an existing library file.
upload_transport.timeouts: 45-second client request timeout; server idle30s/total60s and upload inactivity expiry900s.
upload_transport.credential_scope: Session/token go only in Authorization, with decimal offset as the third field; never session/token in DOM, URL/query, logs or user-visible errors. Transport errors echoing these credentials are redacted. Binary data is not sent through ubus.
upload_transport.server_only: Internal _upload_claim/_upload_done/_upload_abort methods are not declared or granted in web ACLs.

request_rules.path: Library-relative path returned by browse; the empty string denotes the browse root. No free-form path input.
request_rules.browse: offset is an integer 0..4096; UI limit=50, next offset=returned offset+entries.length. Previous returns an observed page boundary. scan_limited=true stops forward pagination and prompts navigation into subdirectories.
request_rules.pause: paused is a boolean; true pauses, false resumes.
request_rules.seek: seconds is finite in -31536000..31536000; relative=true accepts signed seconds, relative=false accepts nonnegative absolute seconds.
request_rules.volume: value is 0..100; mute is boolean. This UI supplies both and preserves the other reported value.
request_rules.tracks: type is audio or sub; id is 1..65535 from track_list. Confirmed id=0 disables that track type; Off is offered only when track metadata exists.
request_rules.queue: action is list, append, clear or next. append sends a library-relative path; other actions send path="".
request_rules.profile: name is balanced, quality4k or quiet. Default quality4k stops current playback when selected and requires hardware decoding on the next play; balanced and quiet allow software decoding for diagnostics.
request_rules.remove: Only a regular file returned by browse; explicit permanent-delete confirmation. A held playback inode must be stopped by the user first; no implicit stop or recursive deletion.
request_rules.upload_begin: path is current browse directory plus a validated selected filename; size is a positive safe integer <=2^53-1. uhttpd injects the actual ubus_rpc_session; the UI never supplies or overrides it.
request_rules.upload_cancel: Opaque token only; same-owner cleanup is idempotent after expiry/automatic abort/publication. Wrong active owner is denied.

response_rules.common: All replies have ok:boolean and error:string|null. Non-status error strings and ok:false are failures.

status.available: boolean; engine availability, not proof of hardware playback
status.capabilities: Per-control boolean map: browse, play, pause, stop, seek, volume, mute, tracks, queue, profile, storage, remove, upload_begin, upload_cancel. File-operation booleans are independent of engine availability. Missing or false disables that control.
status.track_list: Actual mpv array with {id:integer,type:string,title?:string,lang?:string,selected?:boolean}. Only audio/sub entries are shown.
status.unknown_telemetry: Null or missing values display as an em dash, never as confirmed decoder/HDMI evidence.
status.unavailable: A successful status reply may have ok:true,available:false,state:unavailable,error:string; retain its browse capability.

response_rules.queue: list/append/clear return entries:[library-relative string], max128; next returns play acknowledgement and removes the first entry only on success. Memory-only; no current-index or automatic advance.
response_rules.commands: Require ok:true and error:null; then refresh status and queue rather than assuming playback succeeded.
response_rules.storage: mounted,writable,upload,delete booleans; reason:string|null; total_bytes,free_bytes,usable_bytes,reserve_bytes,max_file_bytes,chunk_size,max_uploads,active_uploads safe nonnegative integers. reserve_bytes=268435456, chunk_size=1048576,max_uploads=2. max_file_bytes accounts for active reservations. Mount-readiness flags are not ACL permissions.
response_rules.upload_begin: token:64 lowercase hex characters,offset:0,size,chunk_size:1048576,expires_in:900,path,max_size. Store capability in transfer memory only.
response_rules.upload_cancel: canceled:boolean; false is successful idempotent cleanup when already absent.
response_rules.remove: path:string. Server revalidates containment/type/mount/active inode and prunes matching queue entries.

ui_behavior.readonly_sessions: May status/browse/storage only. Upload, cancellation and permanent delete require write permission; queue:list also requires write permission because all queue actions share one RPC method.
ui_behavior.unavailable_engine: Disables playback/queue/profile controls; browse/storage/upload/delete remain independently capability/mount/ACL-gated. A transfer does not set the playback busy flag.
unsupported: No URLs, absolute path entry, shell commands, generic filesystem/UCI writes or arbitrary RPC methods.
No automatic next-item promise, queue reordering, rename, directory upload/deletion, recursive operations or generic file manager.
No engine installation, service start, display configuration, reboot or hardware acceptance action.
ui_behavior.security: Untrusted names and metadata are rendered as text nodes/textContent. ACL grants only exact airbridge.media methods. Server-side confinement, symlink/race handling, and strict argument validation remain mandatory.
ui_behavior.hardware_acceptance: Manual device test; telemetry alone does not certify HDMI picture/audio/performance. See media/validation and docs/MEDIA.md.

validation.scope: Dependency-free mocked DOM/RPC and static schema/ACL tests only; not a browser, rpcd integration, package cross-build or hardware test.
